First work translated by JoeE22 : I Didnt Mean to Flash My Too-Big Tiger Dick, I Swear!

So, a friend asked if I could translate this work for him since he really liked the first one, so here I'm sharing with you in the same time.

As a reminder, yes this work is mtl and as such, you could consider mine as one, but I reassure you all that I'm very careful, even verifying with online dictionnary and don't just copy/paste the first translation given to me :-|

My first interest is to translate works I really like for my personnal use and then to share them here so that others can fully enjoy them, even if the translations aren't done by a pro.

Enjoy!
